# Original research files — do not edit

Byte-for-byte snapshots of `modifvigne/gabung_coba_coba_v3_4.py` and `modifvigne/dekrip_v3_4.py`, supplied by the repository owner. SHA-256 checksums are in `manifest.json` and enforced by the external bridge. No formatting, fixes or optimizations are applied to these Python files.

Integration, experiment scope and limitations: [ModifVigne v3.4 documentation](../../docs/MODIFVIGNE_V3_4.md).
